content: me.tylerbwong.gradle.metalava 0.5.1 (latest): supports com.android.library, kotlin (JVM), java-library; tasks metalavaGenerateSignature / metalavaCheckCompatibility (+ variant suffix e.g. Release on Android). Check task passes --check-compatibility:api:released (additions allowed, breaking changes fail). enforceCheck default true wires into check. YAT uses 0.5.0 on AGP 9.2.1 with apiDump/apiCheck alias tasks. KGP built-in abiValidation is experimental and explicitly unsupported for Android library modules.
